|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-imustbeallowedtospeak_ai-2026-01-20-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-imustbeallowedtospeak_ai-2023-01-22.png]], 22 January 2023) → [[File:V0-L-imustbeallowedtospeak_ai-2026-01-20-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif]], 20 January 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V) (ALT)]]): '''First published 20 January 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/46c4164e553243da41d2619bc5de512927e7aea0 commit 46c4164]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 21 January 2023<ref name="img-imustbeallowedtospead8b70ba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d8b70bab5e6d97f961c2744b77242248f4d06b96 commit d8b70ba] (21 January 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “I Must Be Allowed To Speak”. Text: “Deploy on table. * '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 20 January 2026<ref name="img-imustbeallowedtospea6cae8c9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d commit 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * Against [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]], when deploying [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] to [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s site, [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] is captured immediately and becomes inactive. It is not possible to respond with this Effect to take a card from Used Pile into hand.
* When deploying [[Princess Leia Organa]] as a captive, she is inactive. It is not possible to respond with this Effect to take a card from Used Pile into hand.
